integrity: Proof and exact-rational verifier included. Scientific statements are same-model reviewed, not independently audited; no claim of formal or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly permuted, independently jittered, two-dimensional n-point Latin hypercubes only; 45-degree threshold lines x+y=c for c in [0,2]. No claims for other slopes, nonuniform strata, optimal-design variants, higher dimensions, or sample-path concentration. The all-n proof is analytic; 733 exact rational finite checks supplement it. The elementary permutation variance identity and the leading-order LHS theory are prior art. Historical publication-priority risk remains.
title: Exact lattice-phase variance for triangular Latin-hypercube quadrature
